evd_title: o4-mini achieved 38.0% HR@5 as a scientific paper quality checker at a cost of $0.038 per paper versus o3 at $0.064 per paper
finding: o4-mini achieved 38.0% HR@5 as a scientific paper quality checker at a cost of $0.038 per paper versus o3 at $0.064 per paper
P: 245 withdrawn arXiv papers with author-stated critical errors (WithdrarXiv-Check test set; Math 52%, Physics 29%, CS 15%)
I: o4-mini (2025-04-16, medium reasoning), zero-shot fixed prompt, up to 5 problems; PDF (also LaTeX)
C: o3 (medium); gold retraction errors judged by Gemini 2.5 Pro + o3
O: AMSTAR Cohen's kappa 0.27 (GPT-3.5) to 0.56 (Claude-3-Opus) vs human rater 1 kappa 0.80; accuracy 53-74% vs 89%
T: Papers withdrawn from arXiv 2007-2024 (by Sep 2024); models run early May 2025; paper 2025
